name: disassemble
description: Disassembles a Luau function and returns a formatted bytecode listing string. The function must be a valid non-C closure. An optional options table controls recursive prototype output, source line display, constant display, and string preview length.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Luau function to disassemble. C closures are rejected.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional table controlling Recursive, ShowLines, ShowConstants, and StringPreviewMax.
